audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly credits Aurora with an 'E charm reset' and names it 'E Stalker's Blink' — Aurora's E is The Weirding, a slow plus backward hop; she has no charm and no ability called Stalker's Blink. 'late' also says 'catching her E Nevermove' — Nevermove is Swain's E. Cooldowns field had no numbers; Spirit Abjuration sustain (needs-antiheal) unmentioned; widespread he/his for a female enemy.
